title: Tresor Globus
description: MESHACK redesigned the Globus floor at Tresor Berlin with a new spatial concept that redefines one of the club's most iconic spaces. A reworked layout, centrally positioned bar, and flexible room structure create a dynamic balance between dance floor and lounge areas, adaptable to different event formats. Combined with full-surface sound absorbers and the Lambda sound system, the redesign merges architecture, acoustics, and atmosphere into one cohesive club experience.
